stemMd: Four tasks W, X, Y and Z must be completed one at a time. W precedes X, Y follows X, and Z precedes W. Which task is third?
explanationMd: Combine the precedence constraints into Z before W before X before Y. All four positions are fixed, so X occupies the third position. No numerical timing information is needed.

distractorRationale.e: The constraints form the complete order Z,W,X,Y.
